effect_description_eng: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 Digimon card with [Beast], [Animal] or [Sovereign] in any of its traits (other than [Sea Animal]) and 1 Digimon card with the [Royal Knight] trait among them to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] While this Digimon has [Beast], [Animal] or [Sovereign] in any of its traits (other than [Sea Animal]) or the [Royal Knight] trait, this Digimon gets +2000 DP.
